measures.id: Proposition to Impose County School Sales Tax
measures.title: Tazewell County school facility sales tax
measures.summary: Asks whether to impose a 1% retailers' occupation tax and service occupation tax (a sales tax) in Tazewell County. The revenue would be used only for school facility purposes, school resource officers, and mental health professionals.
measures.yesMeans: A 1% county sales tax for school facilities, school resource officers, and mental health professionals is imposed.
measures.noMeans: The 1% county school sales tax is not imposed.
